name: grimborne-hunters
description: Grimborne Hunters — 3D dark-fantasy survivor action RPG (Web / Yandex Games / Android Capacitor)

scripts.build:www: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = (Get-Location).Path; $www = Join-Path $root 'www'; if (Test-Path $www) { Remove-Item $www -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $www | Out-Null; Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'index.html'), (Join-Path $root 'manifest.json') -Destination $www; foreach ($d in @('css','js','vendor')) { Copy-Item (Join-Path $root $d) -Destination (Join-Path $www $d) -Recurse }; $assetsDest = Join-Path $www 'assets'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $assetsDest | Out-Null; Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'assets\*') -Destination $assetsDest -Recurse -Force; Get-ChildItem $www -Recurse -File -Include '*.blend','*.blend1','*.bak*' | Remove-Item -Force; foreach ($drop in @('strelok_preview','cover.png','arena_map.jpg','ui\world_map_regions_clean.png','ui\world_map_regions_clean.jpg','ui\forest_stages_bg_clean.png','ui\forest_stages_bg_clean.jpg','ui\dock_tab_active.png','ui\dock_tab_idle.png','env\floor_tile_large.gltf.glb','env\floor_tile_large_rocks.gltf.glb','env\grave_A.gltf','env\grave_A.bin','env\path_A.gltf','env\path_A.bin','env\misty_graveyard\dl_preview','env\misty_graveyard\uploaded','models\Warrior_Run_inplace.glb','models\Warrior_Tripo.glb','models\9864cc7e-23c8-4f19-b851-b58f2539c26d.glb','models\Mage.glb','models\Rogue_Hooded.glb','models\Skeleton_Rogue.glb')) { $p = Join-Path $assetsDest $drop; if (Test-Path $p) { Remove-Item $p -Recurse -Force } }; $mb = [math]::Round(((Get-ChildItem $www -Recurse -File | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum) / 1MB, 2); Write-Host ('www/ ready (' + $mb + ' MiB)')"
scripts.cap:copy: npm run build:www && npx cap copy android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
